name: Black-olive sticky rice
summary: Xôi trám is sticky rice worked with black olives, an autumn specialty on both geopark roads.
howToEat: Eat it with roast duck and smoked sausage on the eastern route, or beside the olive and pork belly stir-fry on the western one.
where: The eastern and western roads, in autumn.
seoTitle: Black-olive sticky rice in Cao Bang
seoDescription: Xôi trám is sticky rice worked with black olives, an autumn specialty on both geopark roads.
